scenes.headline: The Ocean Awaits
scenes.summary: Captain Blackbeak stands at the helm of his ship, gazing out at the endless blue horizon.

scenes.headline: The Enemy Approaches
scenes.summary: Captain Redbeard's ship comes into view, its black sails billowing in the wind.

scenes.headline: The Battle Rages On
scenes.summary: Pirates clash swords and cannons blaze as the two ships engage in a fierce battle.

scenes.headline: The Turning Point
scenes.summary: Captain Blackbeak faces off against Captain Redbeard in a one-on-one duel.

scenes.headline: Victory and Betrayal
scenes.summary: Captain Blackbeak emerges victorious, but at a great cost: his trusted first mate has betrayed him.
